events.text: Root cause confirmed against the live car_backseats session: Keep LIVE reached writeMeshDoc, but the semantic-erasure guard refused because disk still had headrest_mount_left on 8 triangles while the resident mesh had zero named regions after the user's deliberate last-name removal. The conflict picker had collapsed that independent refusal to a generic red sentence. Fix in progress makes the already-explicit Keep LIVE choice carry a one-shot allowSemanticClear only when the picker can prove and display that exact live-zero/disk-named mismatch; ordinary saves/autosaves stay guarded. The picker now includes named-triangle/name facts on both sides, and successful saves consume both structural capabilities.

resolution: The failure was not the paint gate after all: Keep LIVE reached the document writer, where the separate semantic-erasure guard saw an empty resident name table against a disk document that still carried headrest_mount_left on 8 triangles. That was the exact deliberate-last-name-removal state from req_3898, but the conflict picker neither disclosed it nor carried the explicit authorization through, so it collapsed the refusal into the generic red sentence. The picker now reads and displays live/disk named-triangle facts, warns when Keep LIVE will remove disk-only names, and that explicit choice supplies allowSemanticClear only for the proven live-zero/disk-named case. Ordinary saves and autosaves remain guarded; all structural save authorizations are consumed after success. The click boundary re-reads both states and prefers the hot current save callback, so the already-open repro modal can use the fix. Paint-conflict tests are 4/4, meshdoc tests are 14/14, editor tsc-check and full bundle pass.
